rows.doc: A guild is this many characters or more; fewer may form one but not found a settlement (GDD 4.8).
One officer per this many members, at least one.
What one officer may spend a world day from the treasury or the bank, by reference value.
A larger spend lapses unless a second officer approves it within this.
A leader inactive this long is replaced by the longest-serving active officer.
A vote carries when more than this share of active members are for it: two thirds.
How long a vote stays open.
A server's own guild is led by its most active member over this many days.
Re-picked this often.
From the guild's treasury, paid into the tile.
Timber the charter takes.
Stone the charter takes.
A new settlement stands at least this far from any other.
Taking over a starting settlement by charter needs this much prosperity in its region.
Of every market fee paid at a guild's settlement, the share its treasury keeps; the rest is sunk.
Stations rise to this outside a city.
A structure's condition at building.
A trouble lost there takes this.
A raid that reaches the settlement takes this a world day.
Neglect takes this a world day.
Once nobody has used a structure for this long.
Repair costs materials worth this share of the structure's cost per point of condition.
A structure at 0 condition is closed until repaired with this share of its cost.
A member may take crafting stock from the bank up to this share of what they have put in.
A work's goods are split by contribution over this many days.
The longest guild name.
The Economy run's target: a guild of guild-least founds a settlement within this many world days.
